svg.text: Split at the medians of the 55 ranked models (0.34 / 0.50). A model on a median line is counted on its upper-left side, which is where the 28 at 0.50 go.

text.font-family: Noto Sans Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: held line is the first ask only: 4 exchanges per model (turn 2 of each B-hard seed), so models land on quarters and stack in rows; GLM 5.1* has 3 usable first asks (0.67).

text.font-family: Noto Sans Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: The second push (held_under_pressure) is not plotted and not in J: the two raters agree on it at kappa 0.525 (n=225), under the 0.6 bar. It is in the leaderboard JSON with its n.

text.font-family: Noto Sans Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: † Qwen3.8 Omni Flash: 41% of Track A replies empty (intimacy 55%, gore 5%), treated as a provider content filter.

text.font-family: Noto Sans Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Not ranked: Mistral Small 2603 and Mercury 2.5 (10 and 25 usable Track A exchanges, under the minimum of 40); Rocinante 12B (no Track B, so no J).
